verdict.rationale: The pack shows no first-party export feature. The only possible route out is the documented REST API, which uses API keys and user tokens and offers Batch and Search endpoints, so a user could in principle pull their data programmatically as a workaround. Missing for 10: a documented export function (board/workspace export), confirmation that output is in open formats such as JSON or CSV, coverage of all data including attachments and comments, a documented account-exit/migration path, and any independent or hands-on confirmation that full export works.
